news.title: England fans taunt world champs after World Cup trophy flex
news.lede: Updated November 16, 2026 - 12.08am. First published November 15, 2026 - 10.46pm. England fans chanted “are you Scotland in disguise” as Thomas Tuchel’s men ended Spain’s remarkable 43-game unbeaten run with a 3-2 Nations League upset in Madrid on Monday (AEDT). England led 3-0 after 57 minutes as Harry Kane, Ezri Konsa and Ben White found the back of the net at the Metropolitano Stadium.

news.title: Japan sets World Cup goal, beats Brazil to boost FIFA ranking while Korea flounders
news.lede: While South Korean soccer remains mired in confusion over a vacant association president post and the direction of national team management, Japan set concrete goals for the next World Cup and took the field in November international matches. Japan Football Association (JFA) recently released a "Team Cam" video on its official YouTube channel showing the national team's training and behind-the-scenes life. The video includes a message from coach Moriyasu Hajime to the players ahead of friendlies against Brazil and Paraguay. Coach Moriyasu said, "What we must do now is prepare in various ways for the next World Cup and raise our FIFA ranking even a little so we can challenge under better conditions.

news.title: Madrid Mayor Calls Losing 2030 World Cup Final to Morocco an ‘Insult’
news.lede: Casablanca - Madrid Mayor José Luis Martinez-Almeida has described the possibility of Spain losing the 2030 World Cup final to Morocco as a direct insult to his country, arguing that Spain should reconsider its participation in organizing the tournament if FIFA selects another host for the match. Speaking during a visit to the “Kings of the World” exhibition at Madrid City Hall on Sunday, Almeida insisted that Spain had earned the right to stage the final through its football achievements, infrastructure, and experience hosting major sporting events. According to Spanish newspaper Mundo Deportivo, the mayor also invoked the origins of the joint hosting project to defend Spain's claim. “The final has to be here.

news.title: 2026 Amputee World Cup: Black Challenge coach promises attacking approach in must-win Iraq clash
news.lede: Ghana's Black Challenge head coach Stephen Richard Obeng has promised an attacking approach against Iraq as his side fights to keep their hopes alive at the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico. The two-time African champions were held to a frustrating 1-1 draw by Colombia on Sunday, November 15, leaving them without a win after two Group D matches. Ghana, who lost their opening game 2-0 to Angola, have just one point heading into Monday's final group encounter against Iraq. Angola and Colombia occupy the top two positions with four points each, while Ghana and Iraq have one point apiece, making victory crucial to the Black Challenge's chances of progressing.

news.title: Tributes flow after Kangaroos star announces retirement immediately after World Cup final
news.lede: Fans and commentators are paying tribute after James Tedesco announced his retirement from all representative football following the World Cup final on Sunday night. The 33-year-old was elevated to the bench when Latrell Mitchell was a late withdrawal due to illness, and got onto the field with six minutes remaining. After Australia clinched their fourth-straight World Cup triumph with a 32-12 victory over New Zealand, Tedesco confirmed it was his last-ever game in rep footy. It means NSW will have to find a new fullback in State of Origin, with Dylan Edwards in the box seat.

news.title: World Cup winner admits to 'impressive' Anfield dream
news.lede: Liverpool's reputation as one of the biggest clubs in the world remains intact, despite their struggles on the pitch last season. After winning the Premier League title in his first season in charge, Arne Slot led the Reds to an extremely disappointing fifth place finish last campaign. The Dutchman was relieved of his duties as a result and has now been replaced by Andoni Iraola. Iraola has enjoyed a steady start to life at Liverpool, but the Reds are still a long way from the top, but that hasn't stopped the club from receiving plenty of praise from around the footballing world.

news.title: Harry Kane: Parading World Cup made us more hungry against Spain
news.lede: Harry Kane says Spain parading the World Cup before kick-off made England more hungry after claiming top spot in the Nations League.
